# **ENVIRONMENT**
###### Management commitment
At SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L. we respect the environment, and therefore comply with the current regulations on waste disposal, emissions and noise control required by the authorities.
The management is fully committed to maintaining the reliability and quality of its products and services, as well as respecting the environment. To this end, it undertakes to comply with legal, regulatory and contractual requirements, as well as other requirements to which the organisation subscribes related to its environmental aspects, and to adopt the necessary measures to avoid or minimise the negative environmental impacts that may be generated by the activity.
**We actively protect the environment:** :
  * In the smelting process, secondary aluminium is used and thus forms part of the closed recycling cycle of the raw material aluminium. We recycle aluminium scrap and turn it into new products through smelting.
  * We have a system in place to reuse the aluminium scrap produced in the smelting and machining process, either for the smelting of new parts or for scrap.


![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/ENVIRONMENT.jpg)
**Environmental Commitment**
At SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L., our aluminum casting activity is guided by a strong commitment to sustainability. We believe in a cleaner, more Efficient industry aligned with the challenges of climate change. Therefore, all our operations follow principles of environmental respect, circular economy, and continuous improvement.
**Core Environmental Principles**
– Strict legal compliance: Ensuring every process meets current environmental regulations.  
– Impact prevention and control: Minimizing risks at every stage of production.  
– Sustainable innovation: Promoting energy efficiency and good environmental practices across all company areas.
**Circular Economy and Recycled Aluminum Use**
Over 90% of our parts are made from recycled aluminum, reducing CO₂ emissions by 85% compared to primary aluminum. Additionally, more than 75% of production scraps are reused internally.
**Responsible Resource Management**
– Energy optimization through efficient furnace and machinery maintenance.  
– Water reduction using recirculation systems and improved cooling processes.
**Sustainable Packaging**
– Elimination of non-recyclable plastics.  
– Over 80% of packaging comes from recycled or reusable materials.  
– Use of returnable and low-impact packaging solutions with suppliers.
**Hazardous Waste Management**
All hazardous waste (used oil, contaminated containers, absorbents) is securely handled and legally managed by authorized entities.
**Training and Environmental Culture**
– Annual internal environmental controls.  
– Ongoing staff training.  
– Integrated environmental emergency plans.
**Community and Local Suppliers**
We prioritize local suppliers within 100 km who meet our social and environmental standards. This reduces our carbon footprint and supports the local economy.
Every action matters. At SERVIFUND&MOL, we work daily for a more sustainable future.

# WHO WE ARE
### **Family business since 1998**
Welcome to SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L., a family business located in Rubí (Barcelona), dedicated to the manufacture of aluminium alloy castings. After more than 20 years of experience, our aluminium foundry incorporates the techniques of gravity casting and die casting.
Thanks to our totally flexible structure, our high production capacity and our ability to adapt to specific needs, we have established ourselves as a versatile aluminium foundry with high quality standards at the most competitive prices.
We offer a complete service, in which we take responsibility for the entire process, from the manufacture of the moulds or shells that are necessary, as well as the finishing of parts in all the operations requested.
We obtain highly demanding surface finishes, such as polished or chrome finishes, for those parts destined for demanding decorative coatings.
We cover practically all sectors: lighting, automotive, railway industry, electrical equipment, locksmithery, electronics, industrial machinery, catering, ironmongery, etc. If you wish to see a list of parts, please visit the sections types of parts and sectors.
## OUR HISTORY
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/timeline-2024-v2.png)
### 2024
We exhibit at MetalMadrid, Composites and Robotics Madrid, part of Advanced Manufacturing Madrid, at IFEMA, halls 7 and 9.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/timeline-2024-1.png)
### 2024
Expansion of our machinery park.
Installation of a new 250Tn aluminium injection machine.
This allows us to increase our manufacturing capacity.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2019.png)
### 2019
Installation of machinery for the manufacture of moulds, which allows us to build gravity moulds on site. This allows us to offer more competitive prices and a better service.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2018.png)
### ISO 9001:2015
Adaptation to the new version of the ISO 9001 standard, obtaining ISO 9001:2015 certification.
The quality management system is more mature and effective. It is a strategic factor in SERVIFUND&MOL, S.L.’s culture.
We are proud to continue to evolve, to face new challenges.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2016.png)
### ISO 9001:2008
ISO 9001:2008 certification, awarded by the Spanish Association for Standardisation and Certification, AENOR.
This recognition demonstrates SERVIFUND&MOL’s ability to provide products and services that meet the requirements of our customers, legal and other applicable requirements. And it was a reward for the effort developed during the previous years.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2014.png)
### New facilities in Rubí
Relocation to the current facilities in Rubí.
The production capacity was extended to gravity die-casting and new machines were incorporated for aluminium injection moulding. We soon began supplying other companies, consolidating our position in what is now our core business: gravity and injection moulding of aluminium parts.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-2009.png)
### Relocation to Cabrera de Mar
Relocation to the facilities in Cabrera de Mar.
New machines and equipment for gravity die-casting aluminium alloys are introduced. During these years, the art of aluminium die-casting was acquired and experience gained.
![](https://servifundmol.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/servifundmol-1998.png)
### Start of activity
The company was founded in 1998 by the Estrella de Haro family, who had been working in the sector for more than 40 years.
In its beginnings, it was conceived to supply aluminium parts always under high quality requirements. The first installations were in a workshop in Montmeló.

## FACILITIES
We are located in Rubí, 20 km west of Barcelona. We have a perfect logistical location and proximity to distribute our products both in Spain and throughout Europe.
